root.name: ユニオン・パシフィック

companies.name: ノーフォーク・サザン

relations.text: ノーフォーク・サザンの買収を二段階の合併で進める合意を結んでいる
relations.text_en: The two signed a merger agreement for Union Pacific to acquire Norfolk Southern through two mergers

source.label: Union Pacific 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: The merger agreement provides, among other things, for the acquisition of Norfolk Southern by Union Pacific, subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the conditions specified therein, through two mergers

relations.text: BNSFは、同社の主要な輸送路の多くで並行する路線を運行している
relations.text_en: BNSF operates parallel routes in many of Union Pacific's main traffic corridors

source.label: Union Pacific 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: Its primary subsidiary, BNSF Railway Company (BNSF), operates parallel routes in many of our main traffic corridors.

relations.text: UPRRは、北米の他の鉄道会社とTTXを共同で所有している
relations.text_en: UPRR and other North American railroads jointly own TTX

source.label: Union Pacific 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: UPRR and other North American railroad companies jointly own TTX Company (TTX).

relations.text: TTXの貨車は、各鉄道会社が賃借料を払って利用できる
relations.text_en: All railroads may rent TTX rail cars at stated rates

source.label: Union Pacific 10-K(2025年12月31日期)
source.quote: All railroads may utilize TTX rail cars through car hire by renting rail cars at stated rates.

note.ja: 公式資料で確認できた関係だけを載せています。投資判断を勧めるものではありません。
note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
